goal: One or two sentences: what the increment achieves and why, in the words a reviewer will check the pull request against.
read_first: the decisions and contracts this task depends on
out_of_scope: the nearest tempting change the session must not make
work kept for a later session, named by its plan row
done_means: the focused test or check of this increment
uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q && python3 scripts/commit_hygiene.py
stop_and_report_when: a rule here or in AGENTS.md cannot be met
hand_back: One pull request from a branch named after task_id, quoting the verification output and the figures this brief asks for. Not merged.
note: Adapted from the PAES kit v44 brief template. Copy to tasks/<plan row>-<slug>.json, replace every field, keep it near 300 words. Provenance: the plan row and the decisions it serves.
